title: Verify that a system can allow a registered customer to log in with an email address and password
steps: Open the application as a system
Perform the action with valid input: allow a registered customer to log in with an email address and password
Observe the result
expected: The system shall allow a registered customer to log in with an email address and password

title: Reject invalid input when a system tries to allow a registered customer to log in with an email address and password
steps: Open the application as a system
Attempt the action with invalid or missing input: allow a registered customer to log in with an email address and password
Observe the error handling
expected: The system rejects the input with a clear error message and changes no data

title: Check boundary values when a system tries to allow a registered customer to log in with an email address and password
steps: Open the application as a system
Repeat the action with values at and just beyond each limit: allow a registered customer to log in with an email address and password
Observe the result at each limit
expected: Values at the limit are accepted and values beyond it are rejected
